summary_en: Interim dividend raised to ¥50/share (from ¥45), period-end dividend raised to ¥50/share (from ¥45). Combined FY3/27 payout ¥100/share vs ¥90 prior guidance. Prior period (FY3/26) paid ¥85/share.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, Sankyo Frontier announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The company increased its interim (second-quarter) dividend from ¥45/share to ¥50/share, and its period-end dividend from ¥45/share to ¥50/share, bringing the total annual payout to ¥100/share, up from ¥90/share in the previous guidance issued on 12 May 2026. The prior fiscal year (FY3/26) paid ¥85/share. The rationale cited is recent business momentum and the company's commitment to stable dividend continuity and enhanced capital returns to shareholders as a key management priority viewed over the long term.
